purpose: Granular-bearing measurement retrieval; no response-law acceptance

questions.query: How do granular bearing raw support, braking momentum and positional correction explain high-speed saturated rigid body overlaps?
facts: Fixed-pose zero-spin entry speed increases peak entry and overlap monotonically in the registered family.
Raw support remains present during entry, global cap20 is unused and delivery age is zero.
Correction velocity zeroing is a distinct momentum term; no response-law intervention is selected.
